difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the equivalence, for a scheme X of dimension zero, of quasi-separatedness, separatedness, Hausdorffness and the closedness of every affine open, and shows that then the connected components of X are points and every quasi-compact open is affine (statement lines 1519-1534). The proof (proof lines 1536-1587) runs the cycle of implications through the standard criteria on affine open coverings, and then deduces the two structural statements by a separation argument and an induction on the number of affine pieces. H2: a cycle of implications plus two structural deductions, written out in full.
